latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – convert blog articles into narrated videos via a cloud rendering pipeline.

- Supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, and URL input files up to 200MB.
- Produces 1080p MP4 videos (and other major formats) with visuals and voiceover.
- Cloud GPU processing—typical jobs complete in 1-2 minutes.
- Workflow includes upload, edit instructions via chat, and direct download.
- Automatic setup with token acquisition and session handling; 100 free credits for new users.
- Error handling covers file size, type, rate limits, and token/session issues.
